lead: A `.nvst` case exercises `nvs run`, not `nvs serve`, however server-shaped the rule it cites is.
body: `nvs-test` spawns the `nvs` binary once per case (`crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:344`), so a check whose mechanism is named by a `rule:http-server/...` ceiling is still answered by the CLI run path in `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`, and a group scoped to `serve.rs` writes that mechanism where the case can never reach it. Read the `[[check]]`'s own `args` before choosing the file set: `args = ["test", ...]` over a `.nvst` tree means the surface under test is `nvs run`, whatever the stage header says the stage is about.
